prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Quick Desktop Controls", "Learn how to summon, hide, or talk to your desktop companion at any time.", "Quick Tip", "Press Alt+P to show or hide pet", "Finish Setup"]
1: ["Verify Your Pet Adoption Certificate", "Confirm your pet profile, traits, and desktop settings before final activation.", "Verified Companion", "Name & traits confirmed"]
2: ["Choose Your Desktop Experience", "Select how you want your desktop pet to interact with your daily workspace.", "Select Mode"]
3: []
4: ["Signing in saves your pet permanently to your cloud account so you never lose progress."]
5: ["Preparing Your Desktop Companion", "Rendering pet graphics and initializing desktop layer overlay."]
6: ["Select Your Quick Onboarding Path", "Pick pre-made starter companions or generate a custom pet from your photo.", "Start Instant Setup"]
7: ["We will notify you the moment your pet is ready on your desktop screen."]
8: ["Upload Pet Photo for Custom Generation", "Photo Preview"]
9: ["Welcome Your Companion Home!", "Complete setup now to unlock the exclusive Founder Companion Badge for your desktop pet.", "Founder Badge Unlocked"]

verdicts.problem: Creates urgency and offers exclusive bonus rewards
